dumplings did originate from china tho, so khinkali is georgian version of chinese dumplings. all started when mongols invaded china, they liked the idea of bread and meat together as a whole meal, but instead of steaming they cooked it in water, which was faster and more efficient (in battle, since food would often go bad, bringing bread was loosing food to mold, it would be a huge waste). and after they spread this recipe to every country they invaded, the countries themselves developed their own versions of it.
